confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation and drinks are less certain, and July hotel rates may run higher because of Arena opera-season demand. The FX observation comes from a search summary of RBA data and was not independently re-read on the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Everyday restaurant and café prices are based on comparable mid-sized northern Italian cities such as Padua, Vicenza and Brescia. Hotel and hostel anchors are adjusted upward from those cities for Verona's summer tourism demand.
